title: Matar Paneer
subtitle: Soft paneer and green peas in a cashew-tomato gravy — spicy, tangy and a little sweet.
protein: ~14–16g protein per adult serving — from paneer and peas

method.title: Cook and blend the gravy base
items: Heat {@oil-gravy} in a kadai on medium; add {@cardamom}, {@cloves} and {@cumin}; sauté until the cumin starts changing colour
Add {@hing} and {@ginger-paste}; sauté a few seconds
Add {@cashews}; sauté 1–2 min until lightly golden
Add {@celery}; mix and cook a couple of minutes
Add {@turmeric}, {@cumin-powder} and {@coriander-powder}; mix and cook 1 min
Add {@tomatoes} and {@salt-gravy}; cook 3–4 min until soft and pulpy
Turn off the heat and cool a little, then blend to a smooth puree; set aside

method.title: Peas and paneer
items: Heat {@oil} in the same kadai; add {@peas}, mix and cook 2 min
Add the blended gravy {from Step 1}; mix well and cook 1 min
Add {@water}; mix and cook another minute or two
Add {@paneer} and {@salt}; mix gently and cook 2–3 min

method.label: Toddler — pull her portion here (before chili, pepper and garam masala)
items: Scoop {=½ cup} of matar paneer into a small bowl — gravy, peas and a few paneer cubes
Stir in {@potato:toddler}; mash the peas lightly and cut the paneer into small pieces
Loosen with a splash of warm water if it's thick

method.title: Spice and finish
items: Coarsely crush {@peppercorns}; add to the adult pan with {@green-chili}
Add {@chili-powder} and {@garam-masala}; mix and simmer 2–3 min
Add a splash more water if needed to reach the consistency you like
Crush {@kasuri-methi} between your palms and stir in
Turn off the heat; garnish with {@coriander} and serve hot with roti, naan or rice
Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat on the stove with a splash of water

method.label: Tip
method.text: The peppercorns, green chili and red chili powder used to go into the blended base; they now go into the finish, so the toddler's portion can come out spice-free and the adults lose nothing. Hing stands in for the depth onion would give (onion → celery + hing). Frozen peas work: boil them 3 min first.
